name: fa400_config
description: FA400 fresh-air AHU control globals. Install this alongside the single-chamber ERLELO config; it adds only the FA400 globals and creates nothing that the ERLELO config already provides.

variables.name: fa400_airflow_glbl
variables.description: FA400 m3/h (0.1 resolution) — SUPPLY airflow transmitter, written by fan_control; holds the last known good value while the transmitter is unavailable, with status bit b0 cleared. Name retained from the single-transmitter arrangement for compatibility; the extract side is fa400_extract_airflow_glbl.

variables.description: FA400 C x10 — written by frost_protect

variables.name: fa400_hx_intake_valid_glbl
variables.description: FA400 0 / 1 — written by frost_protect

variables.name: fa400_lindr_temp_valid_glbl
variables.description: FA400 0 / 1 — written by lindr_vent

variables.description: FA400 0 off / 2 max (1 reserved) — written by box_vent

variables.description: FA400 C x10 — written by box_vent

variables.name: fa400_box_temp_valid_glbl
variables.description: FA400 0 / 1 — written by box_vent

variables.name: fa400_glycol_permit_glbl
variables.description: FA400 0 inhibit / 1 permit — written by box_vent

variables.name: fa400_hum_demand_glbl
variables.description: FA400 0...1000 permille — written by humidifier_level

variables.name: fa400_hum_duty_glbl
variables.description: FA400 0...1000 permille — written by humidifier_level

variables.name: fa400_hum_relay_glbl
variables.description: FA400 0 / 1 — written by humidifier_level

variables.name: fa400_supply_learned_volt_glbl
variables.description: FA400 volt x10 — persistent learned supply trim state, written by fan_control. Survives restart; an invalid or uninitialised value starts from fans.supply_default_volt_x10. NOT the applied output: while stopped the applied report is 0 V and this value stays put.

variables.name: fa400_extract_learned_volt_glbl
variables.description: FA400 volt x10 — persistent learned extract trim state, written by fan_control. Same semantics as the supply learned voltage.

variables.name: fa400_extract_airflow_glbl
variables.description: FA400 m3/h (0.1 resolution) — extract airflow transmitter, written by fan_control; holds the last known good value while the transmitter is unavailable, with status bit b1 cleared

variables.name: fa400_supply_target_glbl
variables.description: FA400 m3/h — supply airflow target in force, written by fan_control; served on Modbus input 28

variables.name: fa400_extract_target_glbl
variables.description: FA400 m3/h — extract airflow target in force, written by fan_control; served on Modbus input 29

variables.name: fa400_fan_status_glbl
variables.description: FA400 fan-control status bitmask — written by fan_control, served on Modbus input 30. b0/b1 measurement valid, b2/b3 loop active, b4/b5 saturated at maximum voltage, b6/b7 baseline-reset settling, b8/b9 severe low flow, b10/b11 overdelivery at baseline, b12/b13 LATCHED reverse-flow trip (supply/extract) - all three EC fans COMMANDED to stop - analogue outputs to 0 V, power-enable relay released - and the trip LATCHED; with the independent hardware 5 V fallback in the circuit a stop command is not proof of a stopped fan; b14/b15 the duct is INTENTIONALLY DISABLED in the commissioned topology of the meter (that side runs at a fixed 8.0 V, raises no fault and is not a failure).

variables.name: fa400_airflow_low_glbl
variables.description: FA400 0 ok / 1 airflow below the commissioned threshold — written by fan_control. The supply fans have no run feedback, so this is the only evidence that one has stopped or that the intake is fouling.

variables.name: fa400_airflow_ratio_glbl
variables.description: FA400 m3/h per commanded volt, x10 — written by fan_control. Open-loop health trend: a slow decline is fouling, a step is a stopped fan.

variables.name: kamra_cel_homerseklet_glbl
variables.description: Chamber target temperature (°C × 10) — Modbus holding 0; written by modbus_plc_gateway. The Main PLC is the single command source. The gateway writes both the _ch1 and _glbl variants when present. The chamber program prefers _ch1 and falls back to _glbl.

variables.name: kamra_cel_para_glbl
variables.description: Chamber target humidity (% × 10) — Modbus holding 1; written by modbus_plc_gateway. The Main PLC is the single command source. The gateway writes both the _ch1 and _glbl variants when present. The chamber program prefers _ch1 and falls back to _glbl.
